description: This file defines a test class 'Campaigns' in the namespace 'Step\Acceptance' for automating acceptance tests related to campaign creation in the SuiteCRM application. It contains methods for creating non-email and newsletter campaigns by simulating user interactions through various UI steps.

classes.name: Campaigns
classes.description: Acceptance test class for automating creation of campaigns within SuiteCRM, including non-email and newsletter campaigns.

methods.name: createNonEmailCampaign
methods.description: Automates the process of creating a non-email campaign by filling out the campaign wizard steps and selecting options.

methods.name: createNewletterCampaign
methods.description: Automates the creation of a newsletter campaign, including setting up templates, subscriptions, and populating target lists.
